prompt: The stemplot shows the ages of the $10$ players on a recreational soccer team (key: $2|3$ means $23$ years). How many players are $23$ or older?
hint: Each leaf is one player. The stem is the tens digit and the leaf is the ones digit.

hints.text: Each leaf is one player. The stem is the tens digit and the leaf is the ones digit.
Rebuild the list: $12, 15, 18, 20, 23, 23, 27, 31, 34, 40$. Now count from $23$ upward.

explanation: Read the plot row by row: stem $1$ gives $12, 15, 18$; stem $2$ gives $20, 23, 23, 27$; stem $3$ gives $31, 34$; stem $4$ gives $40$.
The ages that are $23$ or more are $23, 23, 27, 31, 34, 40$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Count the ones you skip
steps: There are 10 leaves in all, so $10 - 4 = 6$ players are 23 or older.
